en: The postcard features a sepia-tone photograph of a man in theatrical costume, identified as Richard Tauber portraying Don Octavio in 'Don Juan.' The text and credits are in German, with a printed dedication and autograph across the image. The back of the postcard is a typical divided-back layout commonly used for postcards in the early 20th century, with handwritten German text at the bottom.
